Name: Inner Focus
Effect:
This Pokémon cannot be Flinched and the Ability Intimidate does not have any effect against it. Damaging Aura Moves used by this Pokémon gain +1 additional Damage Dice.
Outside of battle this Pokémon is able to resist intimidation tactics, fear and stress better than others.
Description: The Pokémon is extremely serious and focused on everything it does. It remains calm and never backs down, even if it's getting severly injured.
